description:
S02 E09 — Last Shot at the OK Corral
Photographers C.S. and Mollie Fly open a studio next to a dusty corral in Tombstone, Ariz., and they end up taking the last shot of the Old West's most infamous gun battle, the shootout at the O.K. Corral.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S02 E01 — The Bone War
Bones, not gold, inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming; after stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man gets caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:

title: The Big Trees
description: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone.

title: Elkhorn
description:

A Chicago cattle baron sends two enforcers to make deals with Medora's ranchers, leading to a deadly confrontation with the town's founder, the Marquis de Morés; sensing trouble, one of Theodore Roosevelt's men heads off to Montana to find some help.
